messages:
anya: quick sync post-RFC / small proposal: add a "micro-adj" stage after scoring to break ties and nudge for cost/latency/region. keep it tiny and explicit.

ben: agree. constraints: pure, no IO, <150us, opt-in per-tenant. default deterministic, optional seeded mode to spread load.

carla: sidecar-first makes sense for per-tenant rollouts. control-plane compiles/validates the micro-adj. router treats absent adj as no-op.

anya: telemetry names: qualifier.applied bool, qualifier.delta_score histogram, qualifier.mode tag. include qualifier.id in traces.

ben: validation: control-plane static-analyze expressions, whitelist ops (add,mul,clamp,seeded_hash). must reject unsafe constructs.

carla: rollout: flag in UI -> internal tenants -> 48h sim -> low-traffic prod -> opt-in. alerts: qualifier.failure_rate >0.5% or applied_rate drift >10%.

anya: config sketch: {"qualifier_id":"microadj_v1","version":"1","mode":"seeded","expr":"score + bias*(region_pref - cost_norm)","params":{"bias":"0.06"}}

ben: tests: unit evals, perf microbench, sim harness for skew, chaos where evaluator throws -> neutral fallback.

infra-bot: deploy-note: branch microadj-shim pushed to staging: https://redwood-infra/changes/microadj-shim :rocket:

anya: action items: i'll write addendum with schema + telemetry. @ben prototype seeded RNG + microbench. @carla draft ops checklist.

ben: on it, will post numbers today.
